LESSON: POETRY 7.2.1 APPRECIATION OF POETRY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: PERFORMANCE IN ORAL LITERATURE Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Sugg
Topic 7.2: Poetry 7.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Poetry 7.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry, part of PERFORMANCE IN ORAL LITERATURE Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Sugg in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 LITERATURE IN ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How do themes in poems from Kenya capture our shared experiences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Poetry 7.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner speaks engagingly with peers to describe the subject

matter in poems from Kenya for analysis.

● Learning to learn: This is inculcated as the learner reflects on their learning when sharing findings with peers.

Values:
● Unity: This is nurtured as the learner teams up with peers to conduct a library session to read poems from Kenya.

● Integrity: This is enhanced as the learner embraces self-discipline by preparing a reading log to track poems read

with information on the subject matter.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship education: This is developed as the learner discusses the different subject matters in poems from Kenya to get

information.
